perf.summary: Hoist this.Buckets, this.Next, this.keys into local pointers before the build loop to avoid repeated field loads through the struct.
perf.currentCost: The loop reads this.keys[idx], this.Next[idx], this.Buckets[key], this.Buckets[key]= each iteration. Each `this.Field` is a load from the struct's memory (the struct may be behind a pointer via Create), so 3-4 field loads per iteration over count elements.
perf.proposedChange: Local `int* buckets = this.Buckets; int* next = this.Next; int* k = this.keys;` before the loop, then index those locals. Mirrors how UnsafeKeyedMap.RecalculateBuckets already hoists.
perf.rationale: Removes redundant struct-field loads from the hot O(count) rehash loop, shortening the per-iteration dependency chain and freeing registers for the load-store of the bucket chain insert.
perf.risk: None; fields are not reassigned during the loop. Pure read hoist.
